`search-page-1.json` and `search-page-2.json` were recorded once from the live GitHub Search API on 2026-11-20 at 08:12 UTC, unauthenticated, with `curl`: `GET https://api.github.com/search/repositories?q=created:>2026-11-13 stars:>50&sort=stars&order=desc&per_page=30&page=1` (then `page=2`), with `Accept: application/vnd.github+json` and `X-GitHub-Api-Version: 2022-11-28`. Each has 30 repositories, so the adapter reads both. They are stored as the API's compact JSON; `.prettierignore` keeps them that way. Response headers were not kept: tests set `x-ratelimit-remaining` themselves.

`search-short.json` is hand-made from them: `replit/datacat` and `gylive/google-ultra` (no description) copied from the recorded pages, a repository whose `html_url` is the URL of the `onlook-dev/onlook` item in `../hn/items.json` (without its trailing slash), and one invalid entry (a `javascript:` URL and a string star count). It has fewer than 30 items, so the adapter stops after it.
